description:
Load the 'Turbine Simulation.wpa' sample project in QBlade and modify the turbine configuration. 

1. Open QBlade and load the project from '/home/ga/Documents/sample_projects/Turbine Simulation.wpa'.
2. Navigate to the HAWT Rotor Design module (blade/rotor configuration).
3. Change the 'Blade Pitch' angle to exactly 3 degrees.
4. Save the modified project as a new file at '/home/ga/Documents/projects/turbine_pitch3.wpa' using 'File > Save Project As'.

Ensure the new project file is saved correctly and contains your changes.
